links.outcome: SCORE2 observed-to-expected risk ratio in Dutch primary care patients
links.effect: Mean observed 10-year risk 10.1% vs model-predicted 6.2%; O/E ratio 1.54 in females and 1.68 in men; ~35% of patients potentially missed preventive treatment.
links.quote: Results indicated a mean observed 10-year risk of 10.1%, notably higher than the model-predicted risk of 6.2%.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation evaluating the calibration and performance of the SCORE2 cardiovascular risk prediction model in primary care, finding underestimation and calling for recalibration, but not testing a specific deployment practice intervention.
